result.description:
Our client, OSMO Creations, transforms ideas into impactful outcomes through design, storytelling, and innovation. As a multidisciplinary creative studio based in Australia, they operate at the crossroads of strategy, design, and technology. From their headquarters in Para Hills West, South Australia, they bring together Designers, Producers, Filmmakers, and digital specialists to deliver outstanding, integrated solutions.

They are now looking for a Digital Production Manager to join their creative team. In this role, you will act as the vital link between creative vision and seamless delivery, managing the end-to-end production of digital content assets, including video, motion graphics, and interactive experiences, while ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with brand standards.

The annual salary for the Digital Production Manager is $80,000 to $81,000 plus superannuation.

Duties include:

•	Lead project planning: scope, timeline, resource allocation, budget.

•	Liaise with creative teams (Designers, Editors, Animators, Developers) to ensure deliverables meet the creative brief.

•	Manage production workflows: pre-production, shoot/asset capture, post-production, delivery.

•	Maintain high-quality standards and brand consistency across all outputs.

•	Anticipate and resolve production risks and bottlenecks.

•	Track project metrics and provide status updates to stakeholders.

•	Continuously optimise production processes for efficiency and scalability.

•	Collaborate closely with clients and account teams to interpret creative briefs and translate them into actionable production plans.

•	Oversee vendor relationships, including freelance creatives, post-production partners, and technical suppliers, ensuring deliverables meet OSMO’s standards.

•	Implement and maintain digital asset management systems and file-naming conventions to streamline workflow and ensure version control.

•	Drive innovation in production processes by exploring new tools, software, and emerging technologies that enhance creativity and efficiency.

•	Support business development by providing production insights, timelines, and cost estimates during pitches and proposal stages.

Qualifications:

•	Must have at least two (2) years of relevant experience.

•	Should hold at least an AQF Bachelor or higher qualification, or equivalent qualifications and have at least 2 years of recent and relevant work experience; or 5 years of relevant work experience may substitute for a qualification.

•	Should have at least one (1) year of relevant work experience where the relevant AQF qualification was obtained in Australia; or have at least two (2) years of relevant work experience.

result.description:
We are looking for a curious and analytically driven Data Scientist to join our team and transform complex datasets into actionable insights that inform strategic decision-making. This role sits at the intersection of mathematics, statistics, programming, and business intelligence, requiring a candidate who can build and deploy sophisticated analytical frameworks including machine learning and AI solutions. The ideal candidate is a collaborative problem-solver with strong communication skills, capable of translating data-driven findings into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Collect, prepare, and clean large datasets for analysis, identifying and resolving data anomalies, inconsistencies, and quality issues to ensure analytical integrity
Apply advanced analytical techniques drawing on mathematical, statistical, programming, and database skills to extract meaningful insights from structured and unstructured data
Design, build, and deploy machine learning and artificial intelligence frameworks that support automation, prediction, and pattern recognition across business functions
Develop, evaluate, and iteratively refine statistical models and algorithms to uncover trends, forecast outcomes, and generate actionable insights
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business objectives and translate them into clearly defined data science problems and analytical solutions
Present data-driven findings, visualisations, and recommendations to key decision-makers and stakeholders in a clear and compelling manner
Contribute strategic input and innovation to the organisation's data science roadmap, identifying opportunities to leverage data for competitive advantage
Maintain and document data pipelines, modelling processes, and analytical methodologies to ensure reproducibility and knowledge sharing across the team
Monitor and assess the performance of deployed models, implementing updates and improvements as required to maintain accuracy and relevance
Support data governance and ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and organisational data management policies
Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree or higher in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related discipline
Demonstrated experience in a data science or advanced analytics role, with a portfolio of applied projects
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R, with experience in data manipulation libraries (e.g. pandas, NumPy) and machine learning frameworks (e.g. scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch)
Strong understanding of statistical modelling, machine learning algorithms, and data mining techniques
Experience working with large datasets and familiarity with SQL and database querying
Ability to develop and evaluate predictive models, performing validation, tuning, and performance assessment
Proficiency in data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent libraries (e.g. Matplotlib, Seaborn)
Strong analytical thinking with the ability to translate complex findings into clear, business-relevant insights
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with experience presenting to non-technical audiences
Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and contribute effectively within a collaborative team environment
Preferred Qualifications
Postgraduate qualification (Master's or PhD) in a quantitative or data-related field
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, particularly for model deployment and data storage
Familiarity with MLOps practices and tools for model versioning, monitoring, and deployment pipelines
Knowledge of natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, or other specialist machine learning domains
Experience working within Agile or Scrum delivery frameworks
Relevant industry certifications in data science, machine learning, or cloud computing (e.g. AWS Certified Machine Learning, Google Professional Data Engineer)
Prior experience in a relevant industry sector such as finance, healthcare, retail, or government
Why Join Us?
Be part of a forward-thinking team that places data and innovation at the core of strategic decision-making, giving you meaningful impact from day one
Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for further study, certifications, and attendance at industry conferences
Enjoy a flexible working environment with hybrid arrangements that support a healthy work-life balance
Competitive remuneration package with superannuation and opportunities for performance-based progression
Collaborative and inclusive workplace culture that values diverse perspectives and encourages knowledge sharing
Job Details
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Job Position : System Analyst
Location: Parramatta NSW 2150
Company: Discount Building Material Pty Ltd
Salary: $79,000 – $89,000 per annum
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent

About Us
Discount Building Material Pty Ltd, located in Parramatta NSW 2150, is an Australian technology-driven building materials platform connecting leading manufacturers with a nationwide network of resellers. Through a single digital portal, the company streamlines wholesale ordering, delivers accurate product information, and enables seamless supplier integration to improve procurement efficiency across the building materials industry.

Key Duties
• Consult with business stakeholders to gather, analyse, and document business and system requirements for ICT solutions.
• Review existing information systems, business processes, and workflows to identify
opportunities for improved functionality, efficiency, and performance.
• Prepare functional specifications, process models, workflow diagrams, and technical
documentation to support system development and implementation.
• Evaluate and recommend system enhancements and ICT solutions that align with business objectives and operational requirements.
• Collaborate with software developers, project managers, and external service providers throughout the design, development, and implementation of business systems.
• Coordinate system testing activities, validate business requirements, and ensure
implemented solutions satisfy functional and operational expectations.
• Monitor system performance, investigate system issues, and recommend continuous
improvements to optimise reliability and business outcomes.
• Develop user documentation, provide implementation support, and assist with user training to promote effective adoption of new and enhanced systems.

Skills, Qualifications & Experience
• Bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
• A minimum of one (1) year of relevant post-qualification experience in systems analysis, business analysis, information systems, or a related field.
• Demonstrated experience in analysing business requirements, evaluating ICT systems, preparing functional specifications, and supporting the delivery of system solutions.
• Sound knowledge of systems analysis methodologies, business process modelling, systems integration, software development life cycle (SDLC), and system testing practices.
• Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively within multidisciplinary project teams.

What We Offer
• Competitive annual salary, based on qualifications and experience.
• Opportunity to work on innovative business systems and digital transformation projects.
• Ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities.
• Supportive, collaborative, and technology-focused workplace.
• Stable employment opportunity with a growing Australian business.

How to Apply
If you are an experienced System Analyst with a passion for improving business systems and delivering effective solutions, we encourage you to apply.

The Role

You will be responsible for preparing stormwater management designs and supporting documentation for residential and commercial developments, while working closely with our structural and civil engineering teams.
The ideal candidate is motivated, detail-oriented, able to manage multiple projects, and committed to delivering high-quality engineering solutions.
